The property comes with everything you may require for a unique and peaceful holiday. The property is in great condition with air conditioning (hot and cold), Wi Fi, Netflix, Amazon Prime. Hair dryers, coffee maker, towels, bed linen, all included. Perfect to forget your worries in this spacious and serene space. * * * **MAIN FEATURES** - WALKING DISTANCE TO AMENITIES. NO CAR REQUIRED - 300 METERS TO THE BEACH - 200 METERS TO SHOPS, CAFES & RESTAURANTS - BEAUTIFUL SWIMMING POOL & RELAXING GARDEN - AIR CONDITIONING - HIGH SPEED INTERNET - LARGE PRIVATE TERRACE FOR DINING & SUNBATHING - SMART TV WITH NETFLIX & AMAZON PRIME ACCESS * * * **CLICK BELOW TO SEE A YOUTUBE VIDEO** San Pedro Beachside Holiday Rental Apartment - YouTube Tap to unmute [San Pedro Beachside Holiday Rental Apartment](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w1pUYgXIY3Y) [Marbella Lettings](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtkpR2cdngmsDJw5On-3yEg) Marbella Lettings59 subscribers [Watch on](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w1pUYgXIY3Y) pl * * * **PROPERTY DESCRIPTION** This beautiful two bedroom apartment is located in La Mesana a small development with an enviable location being situated only 300 metres from the promenade and beach, close to supermarkets, restaurants and bars. The apartment has everything you need for your stay with Internet access and WI-FI plus Smart TV with Neflix and Amazon Prime. This spacious and beautiful two bedroom apartment benefits from a large lounge/dining room with a dining table providing seating for six. The lounge leads to a balcony with patio furniture where you can sunbathe and eat al fresco and view the beautiful communal gardens and pool area. All the blinds in the house are electrically operated for ease of use. There is a large fully equipped eat in kitchen/breakfast room with ceramic hob, electric oven, dishwasher, microwave, coffee machine, kettle and toaster. The kitchen is connected to a utility area housing a washing machine and dryer. The master bedroom has a double bed with an en-suite bathroom which has a bath with a shower affixed over. This bedroom also has access to the main terrace where you can enjoy your coffee in the morning. The second bedroom has two single beds and has its own en-suite shower room . This bedroom also has a private terrace area with a table and two chairs if you wish to enjoy some extra privacy. The apartment comes complete with bed linen and towels and has access to a communal swimming pool within the gardens. Being just a stone’s throw from the promenade and beach makes this apartment a perfect choice for a carefree holiday as it is ideal for its fabulous location and the amenities of the surrounding area. * * * **WITHIN THE APARTMENT** Air Conditioning – Smart TV – Coffee Machine – Kettle – Toaster – Dishwasher – Washing Machine – Electric Oven – Electric Hob – Dining Table & Chairs – Hair Dryer – Iron – Ironing Board – Hand Soap (in all bathrooms) – Towels – Bedding * * * **PARKING** One parking space within the urbanisation * * * **INTERACTION WITH GUEST** Arrival information will be provided 10 days prior to your visit. * * * **DISTANCE FROM AIRPORT** Approximately 40 minutes from Malaga Airport. * * * **BOOKING** Below you will find the details to assist you when booking with Marbella Lettings. You can book directly with Marbella Lettings in many ways. You can contact us directly by completing one of the contact forms on this site, or you can email us directly at info@marbellalettings.com, or by sending a whatsapp to 0034 626 973 973. Equally you can use the booking system further down this page. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any problems. Please ensure you have checked the “Availability Calendar” below to ensure your dates are available. * * * **RESERVATION DEPOSIT** Marbella Lettings will initially request 25% of the total payment of your holiday. The final balance will then be payable 60 days before your stay. If the booking is less than 60 days away, you will be required to make full payment. * * * **MAKING PAYMENT** We are happy to accept payment via Credit Card, or Bank Transfer. If you have any problems with the booking system, please contact info@marbellalettings.com with the dates you wish to book and we can arrange the booking and payment with you directly. Once you have informed Marbella Lettings you with to book a property, we will send you a copy of the booking conditions to check, sign and return ensuring you are happy with everything. The booking will not be final until we have received a completed copy of our signed booking conditions. * * * **CANCELLATION** If you cancel within 60 days of your booking commencing, there will be no refund. * * * **DAMAGE DEPOSIT** Marbella Lettings will request a payment of €500 towards any damages and this will be returned after your booking has been completed.
